snippet.title: Second Second - Early Access Trailer(PC,Android)
snippet.description:
Second Second in a rogue-like card game without card-drawing.
This new game of Sinkhole Studio will be released in October 2018.

Second Second on Steam: https://bit.ly/2IBCbKR

Subscribe to our mailing list on the website: http://playsecondsecond.com
Follow the updates on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/SecondSecond
Also on Twitter: https://twitter.com/SinkholeStudio
